evidence: RUNNER_LOCK_RETAINED=WORKER_INVENTORY_UNCERTAIN : LOCK_STATE_UNKNOWN: a legacy relative-path native_runner.js is active; its package cannot be distinguished. No lock was changed.
limits: The tail contains no PID, creation time, command line, parent chain, or working directory for the unresolved relative runner. Its being unrelated is not established by this excerpt.
This review does not assess a RAM fallback or claim native success.

diagnosis.finding: Fresh acquisition passes snapshot=null and admits a readable relative native_runner.js without current-root binding; owned shutdown passes {owner:null} and turns the same unresolved preexisting host into a global veto.
diagnosis.not_a_safety_bypass: The proposed exception preserves an already made fresh-lock admission decision; it does not infer the host workspace or grant a general unknown-process exemption.

recommended_minimal_fix.scope: In-memory preexisting-admitted-relative-host snapshot, active only for owned shutdown of the same successfully acquired fresh lock.
capture_conditions: The original lockSnapshot() was absent; do not populate this permission on stale or legacy recovery.
Use the same successful acquisition process inventory, with valid PID and full CreationDate, plus the exact readable command string.
Parse the actual WSH script argument, not an arbitrary later data argument. Capture only relative native_runner.js script hosts that the existing guard already admitted.
The process existed no later than the identified coordinator and has no absolute binding to the current workspace.
Activate the captured set only after fresh lock publication and exact owner verification succeed; keep it scoped to that owner/token/generation in memory.
shutdown_conditions: Apply all current-root absolute-path and exact live-owner checks before the narrow exception.
Exempt only the same recorded script-host process with unchanged PID, full CreationDate, exact command, and still-relative actual script argument.
Do not exempt descendants, wrappers, Lean compilers, hash workers, or the RAM sidecar by association with an admitted host.
Do not exempt a new host, reused PID with different creation identity, changed command, unreadable command, or newly current-root-bound command.

Preserve the tracked-process drain, own absolute-root orphan checks, unreadable relevant-process handling, exact observer exception, owner reread on release, and permanent non-overwriting quarantine rules.
Never learn or extend the admitted set during shutdown, from prior logs, or from a previous run.
recommended_minimal_fix.terminology: preexisting admitted unresolved hosts; not observers, verified foreign workers, or proved-unrelated processes
recommended_minimal_fix.migration_boundary: The already retained v0.2.12 lock is not made recoverable by this fresh-only exception. A distinct new v0.2.13 workspace can acquire fresh; an existing lock still uses the conservative recovery checks. No forced lock deletion or process killing is authorized.

lineage_assessment.positive_use: Exact PID plus CreationDate, captured launch handles, and validated parent-child links can establish positive ownership and detect descendants. Absolute source/output/log paths under the exact workspace remain useful orphan-worker evidence even after an ancestor exits.
lineage_assessment.negative_limit: ParentProcessId alone or absence of a live ancestor does not prove a process unrelated: parents can exit and their PIDs can be reused. A readable relative script command does not disclose its working directory. A generic not-a-descendant exception is therefore not recommended.
lineage_assessment.reason: The narrow fix uses the unchanged identity of a process already admitted before this owner, without relying on a missing ancestor to infer another workspace.

primary_reference.supports: Win32_Process exposes CommandLine, CreationDate and ParentProcessId; the ParentProcessId documentation warns that the parent may have terminated and its PID may identify a reused process. The advertised schema has no current-working-directory property.

validation_limits.result: Source design review only. Candidate implementation and native behavior remain unverified by this report.
